objectives_fil: Para sa Sambong, itugma ang botanical name, bahagi at nakalistang gamit. Ipaliwanag ang hangganan at konsultasyon.
objectives_en: For Sambong, match the botanical name, plant part and listed use. Explain the boundary and consultation need.

sections.takeaway_fil: Kaso: May matinding sakit sa tagiliran si Paolo at kaunti ang ihi
sections.takeaway_en: Case: Paolo has severe side pain and little urine

sections.takeaway_fil: Itugma ang dalawang Sambong card; piliin ang Blumea balsamifera, dahon, gamit at ligtas na susunod na hakbang.
sections.takeaway_en: Match two Sambong cards; choose Blumea balsamifera, leaves, use and safe next step.

sections.takeaway_fil: Itugma ang bahagi sa nakasulat na source; hindi pa ito dose.
sections.takeaway_en: Match the part to the written source; this is not a dose.

check.prompt_fil: Aling bahagi ng Sambong ang nakalista sa card?
check.prompt_en: Which Sambong part is listed on the card?

options.fil: Dahon ng anumang halamang tinatawag ni Paolo na Sambong.
options.en: Leaves of any plant Paolo calls Sambong.

options.fil: Anumang bahagi, basta tugma ang local name.
options.en: Any part, once the local name matches.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Tama: dahon ng Blumea balsamifera ang nakalista sa card. Hindi ito dose para kay Paolo. 2: Hindi patunay ng halaman ang local name; tingnan ang botanical name. 3: Dahon lamang ang nakalista sa card, at hindi patunay ng halaman ang tugmang local name.
check.feedback_en: 1: Correct: the card lists leaves of Blumea balsamifera. This is not a dose for Paolo. 2: A local name does not confirm the plant; check the botanical name. 3: The card lists leaves only, and a matching local name does not confirm the plant.

sections.takeaway_fil: Huwag sabihing kidney stone ito; ipasuri agad si Paolo sa health facility.
sections.takeaway_en: Do not call it a kidney stone; seek prompt facility assessment for Paolo.

sections.takeaway_fil: Huwag ipagpaliban ang pagsusuri kay Paolo para sa pinagpakuluan.
sections.takeaway_en: Do not delay Paolo's assessment for a decoction.

sections.takeaway_fil: Kailangang ipasuri agad ang matinding sakit at kaunting ihi.
sections.takeaway_en: Severe pain and little urine need prompt facility assessment.

check.prompt_fil: Matindi ang sakit sa tagiliran ni Paolo at kaunti ang ihi. Ano ang ligtas na tugon?
check.prompt_en: Paolo has severe side pain and little urine. What is the safe response?

options.fil: Sabihing kidney stone ito at makatutulong ang Sambong.
options.en: Tell Paolo it is a kidney stone that Sambong can help.

options.fil: Ipasuri agad si Paolo sa health facility.
options.en: Seek prompt facility assessment for Paolo.

options.fil: Pasubukan muna ang Sambong at saka magpasuri.
options.en: Have him try Sambong first and seek assessment later.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Hindi mapatutunayan ng sintomas lamang na kidney stone ito, at walang awtorisadong remedyo sa lesson na ito. 2: Tama: kailangang ipasuri agad sa health facility ang matinding sakit at pagbabago sa pag-ihi. 3: Huwag ipagpaliban ang pagsusuri para sa pinagpakuluan; kailangang ipasuri agad ang matinding sakit.
check.feedback_en: 1: Symptoms alone do not establish a kidney stone, and this lesson authorizes no remedy. 2: Correct: severe pain and changed urination need prompt facility assessment. 3: Do not delay assessment for a decoction; severe pain needs prompt assessment.

sections.takeaway_fil: Sa Lunes, ihambing ang dalawang Sambong card kasama ang supervisor.
sections.takeaway_en: On Monday, compare two Sambong cards with a supervisor.
